description_en: Queries and filters the bill list through OpenAPI with support for multiple filter conditions
description_zh: 通过OpenAPI查询并筛选账单列表，支持多种条件过滤
name: ListBilling

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. In winnexo-cli, pass it explicitly with --tenant-id
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID (WINNEXO platform user ID, optional filter)
parameters.help_zh: 用户ID（WINNEXO 平台用户ID，可选筛选）
parameters.name: wn_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:

start: indicates node creation. This is the default value and does not need to be explicitly set in most cases.
stop: stops a real-time meeting task. This corresponds to the creation of a real-time meeting. Set this to stop after the meeting ends to trigger the call. This is used in real-time meeting scenarios.

Note: When ending a real-time recording, you must set this parameter to stop
parameters.help_zh:
操作项，可选取值：

start：表示任务的创建，也是默认值，通常情况下无须显示设置
stop：停止实时会议任务，对应的是创建实时会议，在会议结束后设置为stop并触发调用；实时会议场景使用；

需要注意：在结束实时记录时，务必设置此参数，且设置为stop
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en: The task status. Running is returned upon submission
parameters.help_zh: 任务状态：提交即返回 Running
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The query start time. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，Unix时间戳（秒）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The actual end timestamp of the live stream, in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 直播实际的结束时间戳，单位毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The business type. Currently supported values: model Q&A (LlmChat) and document library Q&A (LibraryChat)
parameters.help_zh: 业务类型，目前支持：模型问答（LlmChat）、文档库问答（LibraryChat）
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: The unique business identifier. When bizType is set to LibraryChat, bizId refers to the document library ID
parameters.help_zh: 业务唯一标识，当bizType为LibraryChat时，bizId指的是文档库id
parameters.name: biz_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to filter out bills with zero credit consumption. Default value: true (filtered)
parameters.help_zh: 是否过滤 credit 消耗为 0 的账单，默认 true（过滤）
parameters.name: ignore_zero

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的分页数。默认值：20，最小值：1，最大值：50
parameters.name: page_size
